questions.question: Which SQL command is used to retrieve data from one or more tables?
questions.hint: The SQL command is SELECT.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to add new rows of data into a table?
questions.hint: The SQL command is INSERT.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to modify existing records within a table?
questions.hint: The SQL command is UPDATE.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to remove existing rows from a table?
questions.hint: The SQL command is DELETE.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to define and create a new table schema?
questions.hint: The SQL command is CREATE TABLE.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to delete a table definition along with all its data?
questions.hint: The SQL command is DROP TABLE.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to add, delete, or modify columns in an existing table?
questions.hint: The SQL command is ALTER TABLE.

questions.question: Which SQL command is used to remove all rows from a table quickly without logging individual row deletions?
questions.hint: The SQL command is TRUNCATE TABLE.
